notes: SkyRealm Game 0.13.0: portable world backup export/import; visible save errors and manual save control; save when the window closes or is backgrounded; corrected expanded map dimensions; five-room Ancient Ruins dungeon and Archon boss; Frost Titan, King Scorpion and Blight Guardian; volcanic biome with Ember Elementals; meteor showers; three temporary combat tonics; persistent weapon rune enchantments (+15% damage); world map doubled in width and height on every difficulty; new trophies and rewards. Existing world saves continue to persist across game updates.
